laws.rule: Saitama City bans smoking on the street in zones around 12 stations, including Omiya and Urawa. Patrol officers give guidance first; a smoker who ignores guidance, a warning and an order is charged a JPY 2,000 penalty (about A$18.05, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). Designated smoking spots are set up inside the zones.

laws.rule: Flying a drone in Saitama City's parks is banned in principle under Article 4, item 9 of the Saitama City Urban Park Ordinance, because it can endanger people nearby. The page says nothing on exceptions or penalty; the Urban Park Division handles questions.

Kawagoe City bans smoking in its street-smoking prohibited zones, which cover areas around stations and busy shopping streets; the penalty is an administrative fine of up to JPY 10,000 (about A$90.23, RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Heated tobacco counts under the zone rules; e-cigarettes are not covered. Designated smoking areas include Honkawagoe Station plaza and the Kawagoe Station east and west exits. Across the city you are asked to refrain from outdoor smoking in public places.

Saitama Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (埼玉県青少年健全育成条例), art. 21. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
